about: A root with no desktop/web/node_modules/.bin/ast-grep refuses as tool-failed before anything runs: the adapter runs only the installed, pinned ast-grep, never an npx or PATH fetch (`tools: false` runs the case without the repository's installed tools)

files.policy/ast-grep/rules/no-raw-fetch.types:
id: no-raw-fetch.typescript
language: TypeScript
severity: error
message: 'fetch is called only by desktop/web/src/platform; example desktop/web/src/platform/http.ts'
rule:
  pattern: fetch($$$)
files.policy/ast-grep/rules/no-raw-fetch.tsx.y:
id: no-raw-fetch.tsx
language: Tsx
severity: error
message: 'fetch is called only by desktop/web/src/platform; example desktop/web/src/platform/http.ts'
rule:
  pattern: fetch($$$)
